name: Bangla Dialect Dataset: Linguistic Diversity Across Regions
description: A multi-regional Bengali dialect corpus containing 1,530 sentences across 7 regional variants of Bangladesh along with standard Bangla representations. Developed to explore linguistic diversity and train dialect recognition and regional text classification models.
